title: Arm2Air: Cross-Embodiment Skeleton Transfer for 3D Relay Formation
abstract: arXiv:2607.27627v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) relay networks can restore connectivity after communication infrastructure is damaged. Urban relay placement is difficult because line-of-sight blockage, communication range, altitude, and three-dimensional obstacles must be considered jointly. Arm2Air transfers obstacle-avoidance skeletons from robot arms to UAV relay placement through cross-embodiment transfer. Source-domain robot-arm motions from a pretrained Neural MP model are converted into ordered skeletons that pretrain a transformer-based transfer platform, which is then adapted to the UAV domain using limited target data and Low-Rank Adaptation. The transferred skeleton initializes a relay chain that is refined for connectivity, bottleneck capacity, delay, and movement cost. On nine held-out high-clutter 3D urban maps, Arm2Air reduced median end-to-end planning runtime by 64.9 percent relative to the fastest conventional planner. On the h

translated_title: Arm2Air：面向三维中继编队的跨本体骨架迁移
translated_abstract: 无人机（UAV）中继网络可以在通信基础设施受损后恢复连接性。城市中继部署十分困难，因为需要联合考虑视线遮挡、通信范围、高度和三维障碍物等因素。Arm2Air通过跨本体迁移，将避障骨架从机械臂迁移到无人机中继部署中。来自预训练Neural MP模型的源域机械臂运动被转换为有序骨架，用于预训练一个基于Transformer的迁移平台，随后利用有限的目标数据和低秩适应（Low-Rank Adaptation）将其适配到无人机领域。迁移得到的骨架用于初始化中继链，并针对连接性、瓶颈容量、延迟和移动成本进行优化。在九个保留的高杂乱度三维城市地图上，Arm2Air相比最快的传统规划器将中位端到端规划运行时间降低了64.9%。
tldr: 该论文提出Arm2Air方法，通过跨本体骨架迁移将机械臂的避障运动知识借助Transformer平台和低秩适应迁移到无人机中继部署中，在高杂乱三维城市环境中相比最快传统规划器将规划时间降低64.9%。
en_tdlr: Arm2Air enables cross-embodiment skeleton transfer from robot arms to UAV relay placement using a pretrained Neural MP model, a transformer-based platform, and Low-Rank Adaptation, reducing median end-to-end planning runtime by 64.9% on cluttered 3D urban maps.
